podcast.title: Consideration for Sex Pistols
podcast.body: Following the band's exposure through "The Great Rock and Roll Swindle" soundtrack, Edward Tudor Pole was suggested as a potential replacement for Johnny Rotten in the Sex Pistols, though this never came to fruition. "And from there Edward was touted as a possible replacement for Johnny Rotten in the pistols. But that of course never happened."
